title: Whopper wrapper illustration
slide_intent: Connect packaging graphics to the food inside so a customer can recognize the product through its ingredients and name.
strategic_value: The large ingredient drawings and centered Burger King mark can turn a routine wrapper into a recognizable brand encounter.
demonstration: A wrapped burger lies on matching paper printed with oversized tomato, lettuce, onion and pickle illustrations, vertical Whopper naming and the central full-color mark.
practical_value: Compare how large ingredient illustrations and product naming survive folding around a burger.

content_islands.name: Ingredient field
content_islands.spec: Spread cropped tomato, lettuce, onion and pickle illustrations across the wrapper background.

content_islands.name: Product labels
content_islands.spec: Set Whopper naming vertically at the left and right edges, with a cheese descriptor at right.

content_islands.name: Wrapped burger
content_islands.spec: Center a folded burger wrapper with the Burger King mark visible on its face.

reference_purposes.Expression: Oversized ingredient drawings and warm paper color create a distinctive food-oriented surface.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph demonstrates the illustration system on an actual folded wrapper.
